name: Tan Wei Liang
bio:
Tan Wei Liang's journey into the world of motorsport began unexpectedly. A former automotive body repair technician, he stumbled upon a local race team struggling to maintain the aesthetic integrity of their vehicles. His keen eye for detail and unwavering commitment to achieving flawless finishes quickly set him apart. Over the years, Tan developed an unparalleled understanding of paint composition, application techniques, and the unique demands of high-speed racing environments.

His approach to the paint shop is meticulous and innovative. He's not just applying paint; he's engineering a protective layer that enhances performance and visual appeal. Tan's dedication to perfection and his ability to push the boundaries of paint technology have made him a sought-after specialist in the Singaporean motorsport scene. He believes every vehicle tells a story, and his paintwork is the opening chapter.

physical.description: Tan is of average height, with a slightly weathered face that reflects years of dedication to his craft.

quirks: Always wears pristine white gloves when handling paint.
Insists on calibrating his equipment daily with classical music playing in the background.
Keeps a detailed logbook of every paint job, noting environmental conditions and paint formulations.
